title: Personal Introduction
content: Manav Acharya is a Computer Engineering undergraduate studying at Purwanchal Campus (also known as Eastern Regional Campus) in Dharan, Nepal.

title: Education
content: Manav is pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering (BCT) at Purwanchal Campus, Dharan.

title: Technical Skills Overview
content: Manav works on full-stack and AI-powered applications, combining web development, machine learning, robotics and IoT.

title: Web Development Stack
content: Manav is skilled in Django, FastAPI and Next.js, and in integrating modern backends with frontends. His primary development interest is building scalable, efficient applications with Django and FastAPI.

title: AI & LLM Tools
content: Manav has experience integrating AI using Ollama for local chatbots, LangChain for RAG pipelines, OpenAI Whisper for speech-to-text, and hosted LLM APIs for online deployments.

title: Databases & Storage
content: Manav works with PostgreSQL for relational data and ChromaDB for vector databases in RAG systems.

title: Project Experience
content: Manav builds real-world projects focused on AI/ML, web development, robotics and IoT integrations.

title: Hobbies & Interests
content: Manav enjoys turning ideas into reality by building practical tech projects and experimenting with AI systems.

title: Sports & Fitness
content: Manav plays cricket, table tennis, football and badminton, and goes to the gym regularly.
